newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Labour's Clark says won't step down.
newsitem.headline: NZ Labour's Clark says won't step down.

text.p: New Zealand Labour leader Helen Clark said on Tuesday she had no intention of resigning after nationalist New Zealand First chose to form a government with the conservative National Party.
"I have no such thought in my mind," Clark told a news conference.
Clark would have become New Zealand's first woman prime minister if NZ First had chosen Labour as its coalition partner.
